_operation: calendar.events.list (the LAST page of a walk)
_why: P5-005 requires recorded wire fixtures. This is NOT a recorded provider response. It is the complement of calendar_events_list_page.json: the final page, which carries the sync token and NO page token.
_the_point_of_this_fixture: This is the ONLY page a caller may take a durable cursor from. nextSyncToken is present on the last page alone, so a connector that stored a page token as its cursor would store one that expires when the walk ends.
_sanitized: Identifiers are placeholders. Nothing here comes from a calendar.
